name: 94103 · San Francisco, CA
findings: ZIP 94103 (San Francisco) has 403 nonprofit organizations. 186 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 156 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94103 (San Francisco) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 94103 (San Francisco) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 14.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 12% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
